experiment_data.hypothesis: Padding exception_only traces to 2048 tokens (matching full_trace length) with neutral tokens should preserve ~99% accuracy, proving performance gap between exception_only and full_trace is due to information noise not sequence length. Controls for the 13x length confound (150 vs 2048 tokens).
